continuity: A planned nighttime assault targets the Fire Dragon Pavilion compound while Jin Taekyung, Song Ilseom, Ju Hwaran, and Hyuk Mujin are absent.
Sama Pyo survives the attack after killing twenty masked attackers, seven of whom are Peak masters; his combat style relies on concealed weapons, poison, and survival-focused demonic, heterodox arts.
Namho awakens Taishan by invoking the threat to his meat, and Taishan responds with overwhelming force that destroys part of the pavilion.
Jin Taekyung returns to the compound after the battle has begun, while the masked attackers' identities and motive remain unknown.
plot: Sama Pyo is ambushed at night by roughly thirty masked attackers who surround the pavilion and attack without warning. He uses his Black Dragon Saber, concealed mechanical arrow device, hidden weapons, poison, and ruthless combat experience to kill twenty attackers, including seven Peak masters, while holding off the rest.

Namho wakes to the attack and rouses Taishan by claiming the masked men ate his meat. Taishan erupts from the damaged pavilion and attacks the intruders. Jin Taekyung then returns and asks Sama Pyo whether the masked attackers are his friends.
translation_decisions: Use upper First Rate for 초일류 and short spear for 단창.
Use mechanical device for 기관장치 and retain hidden weapon for 암기.
Retain pavilion for 전각 and Inner Palace for 내궁.

active_continuity: Jin remains in the Nanman Beast Palace's Inner Palace as the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and head of the Fire Dragon Pavilion.
Heugung alleges that Baeksang colluded with Dark Heaven but has no concrete proof.
Heugung has secretly evaded Baeksang's surveillance for more than twenty years, including by learning the Bone-Shrinking Technique.
Heugung claims Baeksang exchanges unexplained monthly missives and disappears alone, monthly since last year.
Heugung's loyal retainers investigated Baeksang's secret refuge twenty years ago, but the refuge was destroyed and the retainers died or vanished.
Heugung genuinely loves Yohi and says she chose wrongly while trying to revive the Yao people.
Heugung offers to testify at the next day's Tribal Grand Council if his and Yohi's safety is guaranteed.
Heugung has staked his life on the truth of his allegations.
Jin has not yet informed the Beast Miao King and intends to consult the Fire Dragon Pavilion first.
A planned nighttime assault targeted the Fire Dragon Pavilion while most of its strongest members were absent.
Sama Pyo killed twenty masked attackers, including seven Peak masters, before Jin returned.
Taishan was awakened by the threat to his meat and drove back the attackers with overwhelming force.
open_questions: Is Baeksang truly colluding with Dark Heaven, and what evidence can Heugung provide?
What happened at Baeksang's secret refuge, and who destroyed it?
Will the Beast Miao King accept Heugung as a witness and guarantee Heugung's and Yohi's safety?
How knowingly did Yohi align herself with Baeksang's side?
Who organized the masked assault on the Fire Dragon Pavilion, and why was it timed for Jin's absence?
temporary_decisions: Use the hour of the Rabbit for 묘시.
Use Tribal Grand Council for 대회의.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Outwardly courteous and smiling, inwardly calculating, but genuinely protective of Taishan and willing to redirect blame onto his subordinate.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Outwardly courteous and smiling, inwardly calculating, but genuinely protective of Taishan; in combat he is ruthlessly pragmatic, survival-focused, and unafraid to stake his life.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Childlike, obedient, food-obsessed, and dim-witted, with intense wariness toward strangers and absolute trust in Sama Pyo.
